eventLifecycleCtaSafety.problem: Cancelled, postponed or rescheduled editorial event records can retain a source Offer marked saleStatus unknown; shared calendar previously ignored event-level status when rendering a purchase CTA.
eventLifecycleCtaSafety.fix: The canonical calendar and carousel suppress all purchase CTAs for any event status other than scheduled, and display the lifecycle status; official event site remains available.
eventLifecycleCtaSafety.tests: Canonical official-ticket positive-path suite now tests changed lifecycle for calendar and carousel and scheduled-offer retention.

majorEventGuideLifecycleSafety.fix: Official source lifecycle cancelled/postponed/rescheduled now suppresses major event guide Ticketmaster/Impact CTAs before choosing single or multi-performance sections.

majorGuideTexasLocalSessionDates.defect: Multi-performance major-event guides calculated session cutoff from UTC day rather than America/Chicago; comparison date range could include sessions not in the displayed future selection.
majorGuideTexasLocalSessionDates.changes: Optional explicit clock forwarded to Discovery loader; guide sessions filtered by America/Chicago day; date-filtered comparison link computed from shown upcoming sessions only.
majorGuideTexasLocalSessionDates.tests: Frozen UTC-to-Texas cross-midnight assertions and source guard added to existing major-event lifecycle regression test.

editorialOfficialLinkHttpProbes.selection: Source-qualified future non-Ticketmaster editorial canonical event CTAs, non-affiliate only, stable startDate and ID order; retry only after 14 days or exact URL/date change
editorialOfficialLinkHttpProbes.purpose: Public official provider URL HTTP reachability with strict host allowlist, no restricted API access or CAPTCHA bypass
editorialOfficialLinkHttpProbes.mergeProtection: Uses existing sync/finisher source-protected ledger paths and automatic event refresh PR; no new cron
editorialOfficialLinkHttpProbes.tests: node --test scripts/events/verify-editorial-ticket-links.test.mjs; protected premerge and existing ticketing validator
editorialOfficialLinkHttpProbes.productionVerification: Merged #6053; code and tests present in existing daily Texas event sync workflow, but no post-merge scheduled editorial probe run was independently observed as of October 27. Do not infer external seller reachability or live seats.

editorialCheckoutRedirectQueryIntegrity.issue: Public editorial seller probe classified a 3xx as same destination if host+path matched, even when query parameters changed the selected date, showtime or ticketed performance.
editorialCheckoutRedirectQueryIntegrity.fix: Require exact scheme, host, path and search parameters; allow harmless fragment-only differences; flag changed checkout identity as REDIRECT_DIFFERENT_DESTINATION_REVIEW, never seat inventory.
editorialCheckoutRedirectQueryIntegrity.tests: Four new regression cases added to existing bounded editorial seller probe test suite; protected ticketing premerge and scheduled test gates required.

canonicalProviderTicketIdentity.issue: Editorial official admission and an exact Ticketmaster provider feed could retain two internal link records because the previous merge keyed on affiliate wrapper instead of underlying event checkout.
canonicalProviderTicketIdentity.fix: Deduplicate exact official destination excluding URL fragment but retaining showtime/query identity; prefer authorized exact Impact, reject unrelated sponsored redirects, honor provider off-sale status for same checkout.
canonicalProviderTicketIdentity.regression: Seven architecture validator assertions for source order, publisher attribution, wrong event, fragment-only duplicates, distinct performance queries and provider off-sale.

organizerOfferPublicationWindows.defect: Unexpired organizer page could produce ticket links from expired, future, sold-out or malformed Event schema Offer metadata.
